sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We appreciate your revised offer, though the gap between our positions remains significant.
In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are making another step towards you with a price of €51.40.
We hope this demonstrates our commitment to finding a mutually acceptable solution and look forward to your response.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We appreciate your continued steps, but the gap between our positions remains quite large.
To keep our long-standing partnership strong, we are willing to make another concession to €51.10.
We ask that you make a more substantial move towards our position so we can conclude this negotiation soon.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For many years, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying robust castings to Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We appreciate your continued steps towards our position. In response, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.70. 

For this agreement, our proposal is a price of €50.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

I trust this brings us near the conclusion of our negotiation. My team and I look forward to continuing our long-standing partnership with your esteemed company.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued steps towards our position. For generations, Demo Gießerei GmbH has stood for craftsmanship and true partnership in our region, and we value the long relationship we share with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. In response, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.50 per unit. 

Our Angebot includes a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026, alongside a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. 

We are very close to an agreement, and I trust this step will bridge the remaining gap. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
